edition: GOST 26020-83 hot-rolled parallel-flange I-beams (series Б, Ш, К, Д)
source: Published tables (see 'sources' and skyframe/docs/SECTION_SOURCES.md). Series Ш, К and Д print dimensions, area and mass only: their section properties are computed exactly from the published dimensions (listed in 'computed').

sources.GOST-CALCX: GOST 26020-83 dimensions, A, mass as transcribed in vkorotenko/calcxactive @9599e47 (MIT), src/typos/data26020.js
sources.GOST-KUVBUR: GOST 26020-83 series Б full property table (Iy, Wy, Sy, iy, Iz, Wz, iz) as transcribed in kuvbur/gdl_macro @026532c (MIT), hsf/metall/sortament/дв_Двутавр_Б_по_ГОСТ_26020-83.txt

conventions: local 3 = major axis, 2 = minor; d along local 2.  As2 = d*tw, As3 = 5/3*bf*tf.  x0 = y0 = 0 (doubly symmetric). GOST y-y (major) = local 3; Z33 = 2 Sy (tabulated half-section static moment).
notes: 90Б1: h 898 -> 893 mm (kuvbur; matches its Wy = Iy/(h/2))
